verdict.rationale: Direct evidence confirms PDFs and MS Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) can be POSTed via the `file` field without hosting, and the OSS Docker image bundles LibreOffice specifically to convert these formats, with native PDF fetch-by-URL also supported. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of extraction quality/fidelity for Office formats specifically (community evidence only covers auth/404 issues unrelated to file uploads), and no benchmark data on accuracy across file types.
